verdict.rationale: Synctera records KYC/KYB identity and watchlist results as `verification` objects (synctera-docs-9) and supports customers in a `PROSPECT` state before activation (synctera-docs-18). It offers a document-verification capability (synctera-docs-10) and enhanced due diligence for submitting additional information on high-risk customers (synctera-docs-28). Its ops platform is marketed for shared workflows with the bank partner and has case notifications (synctera-docs-16, synctera-docs-27). The pieces exist, but none of the evidence shows an actual onboarding queue view, and missing for 10: an explicit view of why an application is pending, a documented workflow for uploading documents in response to a pending application, a clear split between fintech and bank decisions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
